articles.title: US Stock Market: Nvidia earnings to test AI boom as markets brace for sharp move

This situation impacts the banks' ability to secure international funding.

Concurrently, other precious metals, including silver, platinum, and palladium, experienced slight increases, reflecting ongoing global economic concerns and trade tensions impacting market dynamics.

articles.title: Oil prices slide 2% on Iran-Oman talks to reopen Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Oil prices have dropped following the revival of discussions between Iran and Oman regarding the management of the Strait of Hormuz. The losses across both benchmarks highlight the market's reaction to navigation issues. Despite uncertainty gripping the market, some bargain buying has emerged, preventing further price decreases, while the U.S. is shifting personnel to its Middle Eastern diplomatic missions.

articles.title: Gross FDI climbs as net inflows turn positive
articles.description: Gross foreign direct investment into India saw a significant rise in June. Net FDI also increased substantially, recovering from a previous month's outflow. Outward FDI, however, continued its downward trend for the past two months. Financial, insurance, and business services were key sectors for outward investments. Manufacturing and trade sectors also witnessed outward FDI activity.

articles.title: Outward remittances under LRS up at $2.5 billion
articles.description: In June, the total outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme soared to $2.5 billion. Notably, Indians disbursed $1.3 billion on international travel, reflecting a significant uptick from the previous month. Meanwhile, expenditure on overseas education rose to $96 million. Additionally, remittances for the upkeep of close relatives accounted for $287 million, while investments in equity and debt attracted $456 million from Indian residents.

articles.title: Axis Bank set to raise $700 million through ECB swap facility
articles.description: Axis Bank is set to secure seven hundred million dollars through a dedicated external commercial borrowing facility. This loan features two tranches with tenures of three and five years. The arrangement is spearheaded by CTBC Bank from Taiwan and United Overseas Bank from Singapore, with significant contributions from the World Bank's IFC. Additional banks are anticipated to participate as the syndication phase unfolds.

articles.title: Real estate sector likely to remain resilient despite West Asia crisis: CareEdge
articles.description: India's real estate sector is expected to remain broadly resilient despite geopolitical uncertainty arising from the West Asia crisis, with healthy demand, strong developer balance sheets and robust office leasing likely to cushion near-term pressures. However, prolonged elevated crude prices could raise construction costs by 2-3 per cent and weigh on affordable housing and highly leveraged developers, according to a report by CareEdge Ratings.

articles.title: Arkade Developers to rebuild 4 projects in Mumbai, eyes Rs 5000 cr revenue

articles.title: German finance ministry links high borrowing costs to security overhaul

The broader trend came even as emerging-market debt attracted $26.7 billion globally in July.
